goal: Make the existing Longcycle governance executable by three independent Fresh Agents: one global coordinator and isolated Banking and Shipping leads, with automatic S-without-H recovery, bounded goal reconstruction, sparse industry exploration, safe Drive/database coordination, and explicit shielding of already-corrected legacy research state.
baseline_impact: none; this is a routing/manual and role-prompt consolidation of existing CAP-0006, CAP-0009, and CAP-0010 contracts and does not change Evidence, PIT/no-lookahead, Reality/Judgment/Outcome, provenance, source authority, seal immutability, or database-generation authority
schema_impact: documentation and current governance metadata only; no product schema, migration, capability owner, worker reservation, cursor, research artifact, or database generation changes
acceptance: The manual explains the single global control plane, isolated worker control planes, one serial integration lane, durable roles, disposable Agent instances, and bounded hot-state growth in plain language.
Each of the coordinator, Banking, and Shipping prompts can independently recover terminal, long, medium, short, workstream, and atomic goals from refreshed remote state without old chat history.

Each worker prompt derives CLEAN, RECOVERY_REQUIRED, or BLOCKED before work and requires an S substantive push followed by a cursor-only H acknowledgement, with S-without-H repaired before any new task.
The prompts preserve one-writer-per-worker isolation and route shared functionality plus database-generation promotion through global_serial rather than cross-writing.

Banking's legacy prose seal and Shipping's two premature structured seals remain immutable cold provenance, are excluded from current seal/Evidence state by their existing exact corrections or supersessions, and are never physically deleted by this change.

Industry recursion uses one bounded sparse map and one next probe, permits campaign-local learning, and stops by measured novelty, negative space, and independent challenge rather than heading completion or fixed quotas.
L3/L4 work is stopped and explained to the user in six plain-language fields; this change itself remains L2 and introduces no Baseline decision.
Focused validation checks structure, continuity, capability admission, exact seal shielding, and remote CI without brittle wording, lead-count, ontology-size, dialogue-count, or time quotas.
